findings.evidence: plan Task 2 places GitPackSource before canonicalization, but source.py validates deskpet-pack.json before returning.
findings.root_cause: The existing source adapter accepts an already-canonical pack, while this workflow needs a bounded raw-Git transport before canonicalization.

findings.evidence: main.py builds first-party Skill resolvers/resource records once; Manager bindings do not feed a Project-scoped dynamic resolver.
findings.root_cause: Manager catalog authority and SDK Skill discovery/page-in authority are separate projections.

findings.evidence: manager.py lifecycle aggregate is one operation, pack, publish intent and binding; no multi-pack durable aggregate exists.
findings.root_cause: Accepted all-old/all-new is a multi-pack aggregate with no defined owner or reconciliation state machine.

findings.evidence: Current Settings confirm carries staging_id/approve only; plan did not define one host-owned receipt shared with chat HITL.
findings.root_cause: Two confirmation surfaces lack one replay-safe authority bound to exact staged content and Project identity.

findings.evidence: Project relocation increments revision; a literal revision-bearing binding key would make existing installs invisible without defined semantics.
findings.root_cause: Run-admission revision identity was reused as durable installation identity without defining relocation behavior.

findings.evidence: GitPackSource discards command stdout and deletes .git before returning; StagedPack lacks resolved commit evidence.
findings.root_cause: Git checkout destroys repository metadata without exporting the peeled commit required by confirmation and idempotency.
